entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [JIT] Idea: rebalance chains of relational compares against constants (switch `when` guards) into a binary search #136039
  • [dotnet 11 rc2, `linux-bionic-arm64`]: Segmentation fault, no matter what #136036
  • JIT: `endfinally` in a catch handler or filter crashes the optimizing JIT on .NET 10 instead of throwing InvalidProgramException #136035
  • riscv64: 64-bit constant in method data truncated to 4 bytes (ulong division by constant gives wrong results) #136034
  • SslStream: malformed ClientHellos crash servers on 8.0/9.0/10.0 — #126352 bounds guards not backported (5 repro payloads) #136032
  • [NativeAOT, Linux] Lock statics initialization re-enters UTF8Encoding's class constructor and fails fast #136031
  • `ImmutableList<T>.Reverse()` takes O(n log n) time: it swaps the ends pair by pair through `ReplaceAt` #136030
  • ImmutableArray<T>.Builder.InsertRange returns unexpected values when it use the same instance #136026
  • [API Proposal]: Add a Priority Selector Overload to PriorityQueue.EnqueueRange #136025
  • x86: since #135793, localloc epilogs use `mov esp, ebp`, which the GC-info epilog decoder rejects (assert in `SKIP_LEA_ESP_EBP`) #136020
  • Runtime-created threads don't follow cgroup cpuset changes on Linux 6.2+ #136015

Closed

  • Helper-based tail call with a Span<double> argument corrupts memory (Windows x64, Debug/MinOpts) #136010
